{{Quote|<small>STADIUM TEN: TAKE AIR TRANSIT GREEN.</small>|The text of a sign in Eusebus|<ref name="Dangerous Game" />}}
'''Stadium Ten''' was a location in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Eusebus]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Euceron]]. A person could reach the stadium by taking [[Air Transit Green]] from the city's [[Main boulevard of Eusebus|main boulevard]].<ref name="Dangerous Game" />
